content: 1. Elevated plasma concentrations of certain drugs can lead to severe or life-threatening events. Close monitoring is essential when co-administering elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF with chlorpheniramine, as this combination increases chlorpheniramine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are recommended. 2. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases chlorpromazine levels by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution when used with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause serious or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 3. Co-administration of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF with choline magnesium trisalicylate can increase the toxicity of either drug by reducing renal clearance. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. 4. Toxicity may occur when emtricitabine and tenofovir are co-administered with other drugs primarily excreted via glomerular filtration or active tubular secretion, such as high-dose or multiple-dose NSAIDs. Alternative therapies to NSAIDs should be considered, and close monitoring is required. 5. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases levels of inhaled ciclesonide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are recommended. Elevated plasma concentrations of CYP3A4 substrates can lead to serious or life-threatening events, necessitating close monitoring. 6. Co-administration of cidofovir with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity due to reduced renal clearance. Caution and close monitoring are required. 7. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases cilostazol levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Elevated plasma concentrations of CYP3A4 substrates can result in severe or life-threatening events. 8. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases cinacalcet levels by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, necessitates caution with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause serious or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 9. Co-administration of cisplatin with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are recommended. 10. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases citalopram levels by inhibiting both CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 11. Co-administration of clarithromycin with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the levels of both drugs by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. In severe cases, alternative drugs should be considered. 12. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases clomipramine levels by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 13. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases clonazepam levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are recommended. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, may necessitate benzodiazepine dose reduction. 14. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases clorazepate levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, may require benzodiazepine dose reduction. 15. Co-administration of cobicistat with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF is contraindicated due to pharmacodynamic synergy, which can lead to increased drug levels or effects. 16. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases topical cocaine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 17. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases codeine levels by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 18. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases colchicine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. Co-administration is contraindicated in patients with renal or hepatic impairment, and colchicine dosage modification is necessary. 19. Co-administration of colistin with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Caution and close monitoring are advised. 20. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases conivaptan levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. In severe cases, alternative drugs should be considered. 21. Co-administration of iodinated contrast media with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. 22. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases copanlisib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. If co-administration with strong CYP3A inhibitors cannot be avoided, reduce the copanlisib dose to 45 mg. 23. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases crizotinib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 24. Crofelemer increases elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. Crofelemer minimally inhibits systemic CYP3A4 due to limited absorption but may inhibit it in the gut. 25. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases cyclophosphamide levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cyclophosphamide may also increase elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels, but the clinical significance is unknown. 26. Co-administration of cyclosporine with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases nephrotoxicity and/or ototoxicity. Caution and close monitoring are recommended. 27. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dabigatran levels by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. Caution and close monitoring are required. Avoid co-administration in atrial fibrillation patients with CrCl <30 mL/min or in DVT/PE treatment patients with CrCl <50 mL/min. 28. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dabrafenib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. In severe cases, alternative drugs should be considered. 29. Danazol increases elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. 30. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dantrolene levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 31. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dapsone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism but decreases dapsone levels by inducing CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. Elvitegravir is a moderate CYP2C9 inducer. 32. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases daridorexant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. In severe cases, alternative drugs should be considered. 33. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases darifenacin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 34. Co-administration of darunavir with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF is contraindicated due to overlapping metabolic pathways and potential for increased drug levels or effects. 35. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dasatinib levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 36. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases deflazacort levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are required. Reduce the deflazacort dose to one-third of the recommended dose when co-administered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 37. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases desipramine levels by inhibiting CYP2D6 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP2D6 inhibitor, requires caution with CYP2D6 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 38. Dexamethasone decreases elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. 39. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dexamethasone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are necessary. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, is contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that may cause severe or life-threatening events at elevated plasma concentrations. 40. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases diazepam levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are recommended. Cobicistat, a CYP3A4 inhibitor, may necessitate benzodiazepine dose reduction. 41. Co-administration of diclofenac with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases the toxicity of both drugs by reducing renal clearance. Therapy adjustments or close monitoring are advised. Elvitegravir is a moderate CYP2C9 inducer. 42. Co-administration of didanosine with elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF is contraindicated. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF is a complete regimen for HIV and should not be combined with other antiretroviral agents.
